commit c0f5be7d77bb51a61cf5745f43be907a197aae98
Date: Fri Jan 22 13:58:20 2016 +0100

Modified path uniqueness contraint for AbstractFiles to be configurable via structr.conf using application.filesystem.unique.paths.

diff --git a/structr-ui/src/main/java/org/structr/web/entity/AbstractFile.java b/structr-ui/src/main/java/org/structr/web/entity/AbstractFile.java
index 5cbf58336..1c3498eab 100644
--- a/structr-ui/src/main/java/org/structr/web/entity/AbstractFile.java
+++ b/structr-ui/src/main/ja...

result.reasoning: This commit introduced the `application.filesystem.unique.paths` configurable switch (`validatePathUniqueness`) and correctly guarded `onCreation` with the check, but left `onModification` calling `validatePath()` unconditionally without checking `validatePathUniqueness`. This is exactly the bug the fix addresses — renaming files/folders didn't respect the config switch because `onModification` always ran path validation regardless of the flag's value.
